Axle load overloading beyond pavement design capacity

override.reason: Arterial corridor carries heavy public transit bus routes; high risk of multi-vehicle commuter accidents.

investigationValidation.confirmedHypothesis: Sub-base moisture infiltration and subgrade saturation
